features: Equipped With 49 Full-Size Keys, The CTK-240 is a Keyboard Made For Beginners
It is Extremely Portable and Perfect For Your Little Ones
The Keyboard Comes With 100 Quality Tones and 100 Versatile Rhythms With Auto Accompaniment For One To Explore
The Melody On/Off Feature Lets You Turn Off The Melody of Song Bank Tunes and Play Along With The Keyboard
The Keyboard is Incredibly Easy To Use With Its Clear and Intuitive LCD Display
Get A Powerful Sound Output With 1.6 Watts + 1.6 Watts Speakers
Can Be Operated By Adapter (Comes Free with The Package) or Alternatively By 6 AA Size Batteries
